categories.main_business_segments: Science Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: comprehensive solutions for heavy metal pollution prevention, product sales including environmental reagents and copper extractants, and operation services managing environmental pollution control facilities. The company provides integrated services covering design, manufacturing, construction, and operation in the heavy metal pollution control sector, focusing on wastewater, waste acid, and hazardous waste treatment and resource recovery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as waste acid resource recovery, heavy metal wastewater deep treatment and reuse, arsenic-containing hazardous waste detoxification, and environmental remediation. It employs advanced bio-agent formulations, polymer adsorbents, stabilizers, oxidants, and mineralizers, alongside integrated heavy metal wastewater treatment equipment. Production methods include customized manufacturing of core equipment and reagents, with a focus on technology industrialization and standardization of environmental protection equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large-scale non-ferrous metal mining, beneficiation, and smelting enterprises, industrial parks, and government entities. The company serves the heavy metal pollution control market domestically and internationally, including regions such as Serbia and Australia. Its products and services target industries requiring heavy metal wastewater treatment, waste acid management, hazardous waste detoxification, and environmental restoration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Changsha, Hunan Province, and production bases in Hunan and Fujian provinces. It has subsidiaries and operations in Serbia, Australia, and Hong Kong, serving both domestic and overseas markets. Overseas revenue accounts for approximately 24% of total revenue, reflecting a growing international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Science Environmental Protection operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It provides integrated pollution control solutions, manufactures specialized reagents and equipment, and offers operation and maintenance services for environmental facilities, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider in heavy metal pollution control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in heavy metal pollution prevention technologies, focusing on resource recovery, zero discharge, and cost-effective solutions. R&D priorities include developing new bio-agents, advanced adsorbents, detoxification technologies for arsenic waste, and integrated treatment equipment. It also invests in digitalization, intelligent operation, and expanding into resource recycling and new materials sectors, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through project-based contracts for comprehensive pollution control solutions, sales of environmental reagents and specialized equipment, and ongoing operation service contracts. The company secures orders via public bidding, competitive negotiation, and direct procurement, with income recognized based on contract progress or delivery milestones depending on the service type.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading high-tech enterprise in China's heavy metal pollution control industry, recognized for its advanced technologies and comprehensive service offerings. It competes with both domestic and international firms, including global chemical giants in the copper extractant market. Its acquisition of Longli Chemical enhances its competitive position by expanding product lines and technological capabilities, aiming to consolidate its leadership in the sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 927 million, a 14.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 180.76 million, doubling from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 1.83 billion, growing 22.31%, with net assets of RMB 1.07 billion, up 15.3%. The company has shown strong growth driven by business structure optimization, increased R&D investment, and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Science Environmental Protection offers integrated, cost-effective heavy metal pollution control solutions with high resource recovery rates and low environmental impact. Its proprietary bio-agent technologies enable simultaneous removal of multiple heavy metals and organic pollutants with low sludge production and operational costs. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology industrialization, comprehensive service capabilities, and a strategic focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainable resource recycling.
